scope: R3 complete-path likelihood learning diagnostic; not R4 architecture utility comparison or R5 actual future window

optimizer.objective: Per neuron: sum of pulse-channel NLL over 128 complete episodes plus 0.5*0.01*sum(theta^2), regularization once per fitted vector. Each Adam gradient is divided by the number of regime records.
optimizer.trainableParameters: Five pulse-rate weights per neuron; 10 parameters total, held fixed across episodes.

metrics: heldout NLL per episode at initial/fitted/teacher weights
paired heldout path NLL fitted-minus-initial mean and whole-episode bootstrap 95% interval
notes: Deadline/queue field encoding follows event runtime API; physical data generation implementation must be frozen before heldout use.
Fixed-epoch diagnostic evaluates all heldout episodes once after fitting; no architecture selection or superiority inference.
Node hosted execution is distinct from dot target hardware; no wall-clock performance comparisons.
Initialization at t=0 observes the full maturity list after identical physical state and initial held rates; this specification was added before generating any training or heldout paths.
Independent design review before data generation: report fixed-up-channel constants in absolute joint path NLL; they cancel in paired differences. No L2 term in heldout likelihood.

bootstrap.unit: whole two-neuron episode within each of four maturity/shock strata
bootstrap.scope: conditional on this one fitted candidate; excludes training-set variability
